title: Trendlines Galore!
speaker: Tim Knight (Slope of Hope)

macro_themes.view: Broken support trendlines become resistance; the QQQ and SPY uptrend lines are now damaged, signalling a possible phase change lower.

calls.condition: Trendline already fractured (opened below, closed above); increases likelihood price slips back below it.
calls.reason: QQQ trendline violated intraday, the beginning of a support-to-resistance phase change seen in prior examples.
calls.quote: it increases the likelihood that prices will be allowed to slip back below there

calls.reason: Trendline anchored to the March 2026 war bottom has taken damage for the first time, commencing a phase change.
calls.quote: for the first time, this is also taken on some damage and I believe is commencing um the aforementioned phase change of the line.

calls.condition: Silver must cross above the descending trendline from its top before a rally to much higher prices.
calls.reason: Descending trendline from the silver top caps price; a break above would be the first bullish signal.
calls.quote: if you're looking, as I am, for silver to eventually get a rally going and move on to much higher prices, it has to cross above this trend line first.

calls.reason: Post-election spike ran right into the old broken support trendline, now resistance.
calls.quote: And so here once more kind of an appealing place to enter a short.

notes: Mostly an educational trendline video; biases are mild and inferred from chart commentary. No prices quoted.
